card.name: Vowels inside place and surnames
card.fires_on: The vowel piece in the middle of proper names, such as the "a" in San Joaquin, "ue" in Puebla or Buehler. It fires where a name is split into pieces and the vowel pair comes after a first consonant chunk.

modes.label: San Joaquin
modes.description: The "a" inside Joaquin in San Joaquin Valley or River.
modes.example: 980's at the Kesterson Wildlife reserve in the San Jo<<a>>quin Valley, California.

modes.label: Puebla and Buehler
modes.description: The "ue" piece in Puebla and in the surname Buehler in reference lists.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Occasional vowel pieces inside other foreign or unusual words.
